dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: The pushforward measure of X evaluated on the lower interval (-∞, t], equivalently the cumulative distribution value at t.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms the lower-tail term subtracted from one on the right-hand side.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: The pushforward measure of X evaluated on the strict upper interval (t, ∞).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms the upper-tail probability on the left-hand side.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: The pushforward of μ along X, i.e. the distribution or law of X on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the common measure used by both interval probabilities.

dependency_coverage.name: AEMeasurable
dependency_coverage.meaning: X agrees μ-almost everywhere with a measurable real-valued function.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the measurability condition needed to interpret the pushforward distribution and its interval probabilities.

dependency_coverage.name: AddCommMonoidWithOne.toAddMonoidWithOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets commutativity from an additive commutative monoid-with-one structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Participates only in elaborating the ENNReal numeral one.

dependency_coverage.name: AddMonoidWithOne.toOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the distinguished multiplicative numeral one from an additive monoid-with-one structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Participates only in elaborating the ENNReal numeral one.

dependency_coverage.name: ENNReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: The extended nonnegative real numbers, including infinity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Is the codomain of both measure values and of the subtraction in the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: ENNReal.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: The subtraction operation on extended nonnegative reals, understood as truncated subtraction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the expression one minus the lower-tail measure.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Propositional equality.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Asserts exact equality between the upper-tail measure and the complementary lower-tail expression.

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: The generic subtraction operation selected through a heterogeneous-subtraction instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applies ENNReal subtraction to one and LocalDef001.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasurableSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: A sigma-algebra specifying the measurable subsets of Ω.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the measurable structure required for μ and the almost-everywhere measurability of X.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure
dependency_coverage.meaning: The assertion that μ has total mass one.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes the measure of a measurable event complement equal to one minus the event's measure.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.Measure
dependency_coverage.meaning: A countably additive ENNReal-valued measure on a measurable space.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Types the original measure μ and the pushforward measure representing the law of X.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The generic interpretation of a natural-number literal in a target type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the literal 1 as an ENNReal value.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: Builds the numeral-one interpretation from a type's One instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports the ENNReal literal one in the complementary-probability expression.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real-number type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Is the codomain of X and the type of the threshold t.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.measurableSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Borel measurable structure on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Determines measurable real-valued functions and the measurable structure of the pushforward distribution.

dependency_coverage.name: instAddCommMonoidWithOneENNReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive commutative monoid-with-one structure on ENNReal.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the algebraic structure used to elaborate the ENNReal numeral one.

dependency_coverage.name: instHSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs homogeneous heterogeneous subtraction from a type's subtraction operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Selects ENNReal subtraction for the right-hand side.

dependency_coverage.name: DFunLike.coe
dependency_coverage.meaning: Coerces a function-like object to its underlying dependent function.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports evaluating a measure as a function on a set.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike
dependency_coverage.meaning: The function-like structure that lets a measure be evaluated on measurable-space subsets.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Evaluates the pushforward measure on Set.Iic t and Set.Ioi t.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instPreorder
dependency_coverage.meaning: The usual preorder on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Determines the inequalities defining the lower and upper intervals.

dependency_coverage.name: Set
dependency_coverage.meaning: A set of elements, represented as a predicate.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Types the real intervals on which the pushforward measure is evaluated.

dependency_coverage.name: Set.Iic
dependency_coverage.meaning: The interval of real numbers x satisfying x ≤ t.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the event used for the cumulative lower-tail probability.

dependency_coverage.name: Set.Ioi
dependency_coverage.meaning: The interval of real numbers x satisfying t < x.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the strict upper-tail event in the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.Measure.map
dependency_coverage.meaning: Pushes a measure forward along a function.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Turns μ and X into the distribution of X whose lower and upper interval masses are compared.

binders: A type Ω equipped with a measurable-space structure.
A measure μ on Ω equipped with the assertion that μ is a probability measure.
conclusions: The pushforward measure of X on (t, ∞) equals one minus its measure on (-∞, t].
mathematical_definitions: LocalDef003 μ X is the pushforward measure map X μ, namely the distribution of X.
LocalDef001 μ X t is (map X μ)((-∞, t]).
LocalDef002 μ X t is (map X μ)((t, ∞)).
translation.proposition_plain_english: On a probability space, for every almost-everywhere measurable real-valued random variable X and every real threshold t, the probability that X is strictly greater than t is one minus the probability that X is at most t.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The upper event is strict, X > t, while the complementary lower event includes the threshold, X ≤ t; any atom at t belongs entirely to the lower event.
The subtraction is ENNReal truncated subtraction. The probability-measure assumption ensures the lower-event mass is at most one, so it has the intended complementary-probability meaning.
Only almost-everywhere measurability is assumed; no integrability, continuity, or strict pointwise measurability hypothesis is present.
The statement concerns the unconditional pushforward distribution of X and contains no independence, conditioning, or tail-bound assertion.
There is no apparent vacuity: probability measures and almost-everywhere measurable real-valued functions provide ordinary inhabited instances of the quantified setting.
